description: This PHP source file defines the SugarFieldInt class, a custom field handler for integer fields within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods for formatting, unformatting, and processing search input for integer fields, extending the base SugarFieldBase class.

classes.name: SugarFieldInt
classes.description: A class for handling integer type fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, providing formatting, unformatting, search filtering, and import sanitization functionalities.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Formats the raw field value for display, respecting disable_num_format configuration.

methods.name: unformatField
methods.description: Converts a formatted field value back to its integer representation.

methods.name: getSearchWhereValue
methods.description: Processes a search input value, handling multiple comma-separated values and invalid inputs appropriately for search queries.

methods.name: unformatSearchRequest
methods.description: Prepares the search request input by unformatting the field value.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates the Smarty template for the search view, supporting range searches with optional custom templates.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes imported data for the integer field, removing grouping separators and validating that the value is numeric.
